data_fields.donor_constant: RegionDetails[map].music (145 entries by grep; values not read)

best_idea: Play a short result stinger first, then start a quieter bed a fixed delay after the stinger ends, with the bed chosen by the result tier; for a boss or encounter, play its track for one loop and then return to the zone track.
decision_why: Stinger-then-bed and encounter-return fit victory, finisher and boss-intro staging, but the donor cuts instantly and has no layering; adapt keeps the order and fixes the missing-stinger silence.
acceptance: After a won Pit or world fight the victory stinger plays and the zone bed starts 1000 ms after it ends at one third of loop volume; with the stinger file missing the bed still starts (a client test asserts the bed call happens).
